name: Tenant Rights Guide
description: Provides a plain-language overview of common tenant rights including notice requirements, repair obligations, security deposit protections, eviction procedures, and anti-retaliation rules. Helps tenants understand their position and prepare for conversations with landlords, tenant rights organizations, or attorneys. Use when the user has a question about their rights as a renter, is facing a landlord dispute, wants to understand eviction procedures, or needs to know their obligations as a tenant. Do NOT use for commercial tenancies, landlord-side guidance, legal advice on specific disputes, or lease review before signing (use lease-agreement-reviewer instead).
